title: Building subdrains.
officialText:
Building subdrains that cannot be discharged to the sewer by gravity flow shall be discharged into a gas
tight covered and vented ejector pit/basin from which the liquid shall be lifted and discharged into the building gravity drainage
system by automatic pumping equipment or other approved method.
